name: Paste-Up
description: Archivo, heavy, for the poster voice; Space Grotesk for reading; IBM Plex Mono for the data voice.

provenance.attribution: Archivo, Space Grotesk, and IBM Plex Mono, by their project authors, self-hosted from their pinned npm packages for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.

provenance.maintainer: The upstream projects, at the versions fonts.provenance.json pins
provenance.derivation: Role metrics by the platform for the raw-grid direction (packs-plan §3.2); font files copied unmodified from @fontsource-variable/archivo 5.3.0, @fontsource-variable/space-grotesk 5.3.0, and IBM's split WOFF2 in @ibm/plex-mono 2.5.0, never subset or renamed inside.

fallbacks: Each shipped family is followed by metric-matched fallback faces over local system fonts (size-adjust and ascent, descent, and line-gap overrides), then a system stack and a generic family.
There's a fallback face at each weight the roles set, over the system bold for a heading.
Glyphs outside every shipped face's unicode-range render in the declared system stack, so text never goes missing.
caveats: Archivo's wdth file (90,104 B) would take a Latin page past 102,400 B, so it isn't shipped and the headlines set at normal width.
The plan's widths, "wdth" 112, 108, and 104 for display, headline, and title, aren't set, so turning width on is a deliberate change with that file, never a silent one.
Labels, code, and numerals share one IBM Plex Mono weight, 500, and Plex covers Latin-1 alone.
Archivo and Space Grotesk ship upright only: em in running text renders as a slanted upright, since an italic would take the faces a Latin page loads past 102,400 B.

Archivo's and Space Grotesk's latin-ext subsets (32,608 B and 18,940 B) load only on a page whose text needs them, such as ő or ł; a Latin page loads 75,084 B. Other scripts render in the declared system stack.

label.font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", Menlo, "DejaVu Sans Mono", Consolas, monospace

code.font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", Menlo, "DejaVu Sans Mono", Consolas, monospace

numeric.font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", Menlo, "DejaVu Sans Mono", Consolas, monospace
